doc.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023

title: Jamming with Peter Frampton in Kansas City
summary: Dry Jack was on a rock bill in Kansas City, and Lamb and Rod Fleeman were invited to jam with Frampton.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Any other characters that have stuck out in your — I see something about Woody Herman. Well Dave Holland you mentioned. Peter Frampton, why would you cross paths with Peter Frampton?

He was — there was a rock concert in — I was trying to review that history, I asked Rod Fleeman about that when Dry Jack was living in Kansas City and there was a rock, multi- band rock show. And we were — Dry Jack was one of the — for some reason I guess ‘cause we were local, but this was a heavy duty — I can remember the other — I think maybe Ray Charles was even in it. But there was a jam session and I was invited out, Rod and I were invited out to play with him. So that was the — looks good on the resume.
